import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod = 1000000007;
    static long N, K;
    static int MAX_K = 70;
    static int MAX_INDEX = 35;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] A;
        int n, m;

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = m;
            A = new long[n][m];
        }

        Matrix(int size) {
            this(size, size);
        }

        static Matrix I(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return mat;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix B) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    res.A[i][j] = (this.A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % mod;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix B) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    res.A[i][j] = (this.A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + mod) % mod;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix(n, B.m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < B.m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                        sum += this.A[i][k] * B.A[k][j];
                    }
                    res.A[i][j] = sum % mod;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }

        Matrix pow(long k) {
            Matrix res = I(n);
            Matrix base = this;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    res = res.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return res;
        }

        void rot(int K) {
            Matrix B = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] = this.A[(i + K - 1) % K][(j + K - 1) % K];
                }
                B.A[i][K] = this.A[(i + K - 1) % K][K];
                B.A[K][i] = this.A[K][(i + K - 1) % K];
            }
            B.A[K][K] = this.A[K][K];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                System.arraycopy(B.A[i], 0, this.A[i], 0, m);
            }
        }
    }

    static long beki(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0) return 1;
        long ret = beki(a, b / 2);
        ret = (ret * ret) % mod;
        if ((b & 1) == 1) ret = (ret * a) % mod;
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        int index = 0;
        long copy = N;
        while (copy >= K) {
            index++;
            copy /= K;
        }

        Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[(int) (index + 2)][(int) (K + 2)];
        for (int i = 0; i < mat.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < mat[0].length; j++) {
                mat[i][j] = new Matrix((int) (K + 1), 1);
            }
        }

        mat[0][0] = Matrix.I((int) (K + 1));
        for (int i = 1; i <= K; i++) {
            mat[0][0].A[0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            mat[0][i] = mat[0][i - 1];
            mat[0][i].rot((int) K);
        }

        for (int idx = 1; idx <= index; idx++) {
            mat[idx][0] = mat[idx - 1][0];
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[idx][0] = mat[idx - 1][i].multiply(mat[idx][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[idx][i] = mat[idx][i - 1];
                mat[idx][i].rot((int) K);
            }
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix((int) (K + 1), 1);
        ans.A[(int) K][0] = 1;

        long remainingIndex = index;
        int used = 0;

        while (remainingIndex >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0;; i++) {
                if (beki(K, remainingIndex) <= N) {
                    N -= beki(K, remainingIndex);
                    ans = mat[(int) remainingIndex][used].multiply(ans);
                    used++;
                    used %= K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            remainingIndex--;
        }

        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            val += ans.A[i][0];
        }
        val %= mod;
        System.out.println(val);
        sc.close();
    }
}
